The top of the tower is observed from the car and, in the process, it takes 10 minutes for the angle of elevation to change from 45° to 60°. After how much more time will this car reach the base of the tower? Choices: A)5(√3 + 1) B)6(√3 + √2) C)7(√3 – 1) D)8(√3 – 2) E)None of these

tan 60 = h/x x = h/√3

10 minutes = h *( 1 – 1√3)

To travel a distance of x, which is h/√3, it takes :
h = 10 / (1 – 1/√3)

So, it takes 5(1 + √3) minutes to reach the base of the tower.

    def prime_factors(n):
        i = 2

        while i * i <= n:

                i += 1
            else:
                n //= i
                factors.append(i)
        if n > 1:

        return factors
    def lcm(num1, num2):
        factors1 = prime_factors(num1)

        unique_factors = set(factors1) | set(factors2)
        result = 1
